text:
marta: Heads-up, helm upgrade for gpupool v2 in eu-west is stuck on pre-upgrade hook. The hook job keeps failing with quota errors and gitops is blocked :grimacing:
sam: logs?
marta: hook job `preflight-gpupool-scale` failing: `RequestLimitExceeded: You have requested more resources (gpus) than your quota allows` — autoscaler tried to bump nodepool to 8 gpus but tenancy limit is 4.
li: is this the new nodepool-provisioner hook we added last release?
marta: yes. It creates a Job that sets provider autoscaler to desired size then waits for nodes. Fails when cloud API rejects scale request.
anika: is the job marked as hook `pre-upgrade`? can we skip hooks and let helm continue?
marta: yes it's annotated `helm.sh/hook: pre-upgrade`. skipping hooks might leave CRDs in old state; but we could use `--no-hooks` to complete chart and then reconcile CRD separately.
diego: alternative: patch the job to set backoffLimit=0 so helm will move on? risky.
marta: current blockers: gitops (argocd) sees release still pending -> can't apply subsequent charts; rollout backlog across clusters.
ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026, assigned to marta, sam
sam: immediate workaround I did: 1) `kubectl -n infra delete job preflight-gpupool-scale-xxxxx` 2) `helm upgrade --reuse-values --set gpupool.skipPreflight=true chartname --namespace infra` 3) manually apply CRD patch to update conversion webhook endpoint
sam: commands:
```
kubectl -n infra delete job preflight-gpupool-scale-xxxxx
helm upgrade infra-gpupool ./charts/gpupool -n infra --reuse-values --set gpupool.skipPreflight=true
kubectl patch crd gpupools.mycompany.com -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"gpupool/upgrade-skip":"true"}}}'
```
li: that unblocked argocd sync?
sam: yes argocd resumed and other charts progressed. We still need a proper fix: gate hook behind capacity-check that uses quota API instead of optimistic scale.
anika: long-term: change hook to check `kubectl get cloudquota` or query provider before requesting scale. Also add fallback: use existing smaller nodepool variant (cheap) to avoid requesting extra GPU capacity in constrained regions.
diego: cost note: temporary skip caused us to run gpupool at previous size for ~6 hours — added ~$1200 extra in eu-west due to on-demand GPUs. we should add cost guard rails.
marta: follow-ups: 1) PR to add quota-check -> owners eng-platform 2) add argocd policy to avoid blocking entire app if one hook fails 3) improve observability: surface cloud quota failures in console
anika: I'll file the PR and include tests that mock quota API.
marta: thanks. marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
